2 كمّت ثَوْبَهُ (tropical:) He dyed his garment of the colour of [fresh ripe] dates; i. e., of a red colour inclining to black. (A.) ―
-b2- كُمِّتَتْ She was rendered artificially of the colour called كُمَيْتٌ, (K,) or was dyed of that colour. (So in a copy of the K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
